svg.title: Low-loader machinery trailer — Lágvagn fyrir vinnuvélar
svg.desc: A machinery transport trailer has a high front gooseneck, deeply lowered deck and raised rear loading ramp.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-low-loader-trailer","label_en":"Low-loader machinery trailer","label_is":"Lágvagn fyrir vinnuvélar","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["site-logistics","transport"],"description":"A machinery transport trailer has a high front gooseneck, deeply lowered deck and raised rear loading ramp.","design_note":"The long depressed load bed and rear ramp distinguish a low-loader from an ordinary flatbed trailer.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
